# Working in this repo

## Generated files — don't read wholesale

These are large, machine-generated, and checked in only for CI drift-checking
or machine tooling. Reading them in full burns huge context for little
payoff — `grep`/`rg` for the specific symbol or key instead:

- `docs/openapi-snapshot.json` (~1.4MB) — generated by
  `manage.py spectacular`; CI diffs it against a fresh run
  ([ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml)). To find one endpoint's schema, grep
  for its path/operationId rather than reading the file.
- `web/src/api/openapi-types.ts` (~840KB) — generated from the snapshot
  above; CI diffs it the same way. Grep for the specific type name.
- `docs/reviews/MASTER_ISSUE_REGISTER.md` (~1.9MB) — still live (routes
  between the CR/R/BB ID schemes across active review docs), just too big to
  read in full. Grep for the specific ID (e.g. `CR-094`) instead. For a
  quality/gap overview, prefer
  [docs/PRODUCT_QUALITY_BACKLOG.md](docs/PRODUCT_QUALITY_BACKLOG.md) and
  `qos/backlog/*.yaml`, which track current status in smaller files.
- `web/package-lock.json` / `mobile/package-lock.json` — never read these for
  understanding dependencies; check `package.json` instead.

## Docs worth checking alongside `docs/reviews/*`

`docs/reviews/` mixes live routing docs (e.g.
`FUNCTIONAL_CODE_REVIEW_FINDINGS.md`, `MASTER_ISSUE_REGISTER.md`) with
one-off audit snapshots from past cycles — check a doc's own header/date
before trusting it. For a quality/status overview, also check:

- [docs/TESTING_STRATEGY.md](docs/TESTING_STRATEGY.md) — test method/priorities/gaps
- [docs/PRODUCT_QUALITY_BACKLOG.md](docs/PRODUCT_QUALITY_BACKLOG.md) — generated quality backlog
- [docs/FREEZE_SCOPE_COVERAGE.md](docs/FREEZE_SCOPE_COVERAGE.md) — per-item freeze status
